descriptions.text: Make quick and easy circle cutouts using the 1-3/4" (4.4 cm) Circle Punch. Circles are just one of a few essential shapes everyone should have in their crafting collection. Plus, punches are the quick, easy, no-fuss way to make your own creative elements. Try stamping a sentiment, then quickly punch it out for the focal point on your next handmade card, or punch out several circles to create a balloon bouquet or colorful polka dot background for scrapbook pages, gift packaging, and more! What will you create with this handy circle punch? * Punched image: 1-3/4" (4.4 cm) Punches are a quick and easy way to create shapes that add interest and depth to your projects. And punches are a great way to cut out stamped images—many of our stamp sets have coordinating punches. Our punches are high quality, affordable, and easy to use. Our punches also * Have a sleek body style. * Feature a large surface area for precise cutting and leverage. * Lock to store. * Are slim and stackable.
